client.title: Web client
client.role: Submits the customer's checkout request and displays the order confirmation.
client.how: Sends `POST /orders` with cart items and payment details over HTTPS.
weak: Slow responses can cause users to click Pay twice if the button is not disabled.

api.title: Orders API
api.role: Accepts checkouts, persists the order, and publishes an `OrderCreated` event.
api.how: Validates the payload, writes a row to `orders DB`, and publishes to `order-events`.
weak: Writing to the DB and publishing to the queue are separate steps; a crash in between loses the event.

queue.title: order-events
queue.role: Buffers `OrderCreated` events between the API and downstream fulfilment.
queue.how: Retains messages until `Fulfilment worker` acknowledges processing.
weak: Delivers at-least-once, so consumers must be idempotent.

worker.title: Fulfilment worker
worker.role: Handles post-order work such as confirmation emails and stock reservation.

db.title: orders DB
db.role: Durable source of truth for orders and their current status.
db.how: Stores one row per order inserted by `Orders API`.
